segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good afternoon.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Justice Federal Credit Union.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: How can I help you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hello there, I'm Jeffrey.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I actually contacted you guys to know if you guys hand out loans.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Oh, hi, Jeffrey.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I certainly appreciate you giving us a call today.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And yes, we do offer various consumer loans.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Can I ask a little bit about a little bit of questions to you about what type of loan you may be seeking?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Are you interested in a personal loan, a business loan, a commercial loan, or an agricultural loan?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Well, it's got to be agricultural.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: You see I have this farm and basically I'm looking to buy some equipment.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Great.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So you're looking to expand your current operation.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, exactly.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So what do I need to be doing to get a loan for these equipment?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: First, let me go ahead and ask a few qualifying questions if you don't mind.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Sure, go ahead.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Now, do you currently have an account with us?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I do not think I do.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, not a problem.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And how long has your farm been in operation?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: It's been about three months.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And was it a running farm prior to you taking it over, or is it a completely new venture for you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No, yes, my grandfather owned it but after he passed away I took over ownership.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: He left it to me.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So I took over the business with things he already had and it sounds good.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So I'm looking to really expand my selection of tools and supplies to help improve.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So basically, it's been a running farm for several years, but you have had ownership of it for the last three months, correct?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That's right.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And the previous owner, did he have an account with us?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: He probably did.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: His name is Michael Thompson.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, I'll go ahead and note that down.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, great.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And what type of equipment are you looking to get a loan for?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What is the amount?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Is it under 10 ,000 or over 10 ,000?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I would imagine it's over.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I'm looking to buy like most of the things that we have on the farm are old so I'm looking to replace everything that would range from tractors to plows and all sorts of machines.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, great.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Now, do you have any collateral that you will be using as part of your loan application?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Well, you see this is my first time taking a loan so I don't really know much about it.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Bicolateral, what do you mean?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, I would be happy to explain this to you.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Collateral is basically something that you would be using as security against the repayment of your loan.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: For example, if you're a homeowner, or if you own land, or any other type of property, then that could be used as collateral as a basis for your loan.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So for example, this is just an example, not for your specific case.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Say you wanted to borrow $50 ,000, and you use your home as collateral.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So we would put a lien against your home in the event that you did not repay the balance.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: But of course, if you make your payments on time, and you pay off the balance before, then that lien would be revoked.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: In the event that you did not pay, of course, we would be able to file an injunction so that anytime you refinance your home or sold that property, then we would be able to recoup our payment at that time.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is just an example.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: For smaller loan amounts, you would necessarily need collateral, but you would have to show that you have good credit, and that you have been using credit responsibly, and also that you have a regular source of income.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Say from a regular job, like a salary job, or if you're a W2N4E, we would need at least 12 -month bank statement that shows that you're financially solvent and that you actually have the ability to make payments on the loan amount that you are seeking.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Great.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I see.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That's a lot of information but I get it now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So you sit here thinking about borrowing about $10 ,000 for the purpose of purchasing new equipment to help maintain the farm that your grandfather left behind.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, great.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Not a problem.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And are you currently working?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, I am working actually.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I have another company of my own that I work at.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So it's your own company, so make sure you're self -employed, or are you working for someone else?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I am self -employed, yes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And what is your monthly income?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Approximate?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That'll be approximately, I'd say about $1 ,200 per

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: $1 ,200 per month?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: month, yes.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: On an average,

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, thank you so much.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I didn't send information in.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Do you have a mortgage, or are you renting friendly?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I am currently renting.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, and what is your monthly rent?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That would be around $700.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And do you have any other expenses that I should know about?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Currently, no.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay,

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: thank you.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, I just put all that information in there. I

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: have an idea of what your credit score may be.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I haven't checked it recently but it should be around $400, I believe.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, thank you, information.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And is there anyone who would be able to be a cold borrower on this loan?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I could ask my wife.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, it would be my wife.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you. Okay,

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: based on the information you have provided for me, it is not likely that we would be able to extend a loan to you at this time, mainly for a few reasons, which I will explain to you.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We do need a minimum credit score of $650 for any loan that we offer through our credit union here.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And for a loan $10 ,000 or more, you would need at least a $4 ,000 monthly income in order to qualify.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And with your $400 credit and your $1 ,200 a month income, which also, which most of it goes towards your living, you would not, according to our calculations, you would not be able to make payments on a loan at this time.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I see.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What I can do is send you some information to help you get your credit in order and some budgeting tips that may help you to get on a better path towards financial solvency so you can reply maybe six months or one year down the line. You

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I see.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No, that won't be necessary.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thank you for all your time.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: are most welcome and do feel free to give us a call anytime.

segments.text: Yes, of course.
